scoring_flat: pts/game ~45 for a decade (2015-19: 45.4, 2021-25: 45.0). 'Overs keep rising' is a MYTH. 2020 COVID spike 49.6 only.
ou_efficient: over vs closing total = 48.8% (n=6967). Mild under lean, NOT exploitable blindly (need 52.4%). 2024-25 blipped to ~53% over.
hfa_collapsed: home margin 2.3-2.4 pts (2006-2018) -> 1.49 (2019-2025). Biggest structural shift in the sport.
road_dog_edge: road dogs covered 53.8% (2019-25) BUT it's DECAYING: 0.61/0.55/0.55/0.56 (2019-22) -> 0.50/0.47/0.52 (2023-25). Market adjusted to HFA collapse. NOT a live edge anymore — Graveyard.
pass_rate_declining: 59.9% (2016) -> 56.8% (2025). Modest rushing tailwind, passing headwind for props.
usage: Mostly myth-busting: scoring is flat (fade 'overs rising'), O/U is efficient, road-dog edge is priced out. Live-usable: pass-rate decline for prop calibration; HFA=1.5 (already in engine).
